title: Quantitative Osgood regularity for DiPerna--Lions flows
summary: We study the spatial regularity of regular Lagrangian flows associated with vector fields in the DiPerna--Lions class \(\boldsymbol b\in L^1((0,T);W^{1,1}_{\loc}(\mathbb R^d)), \) under the standard growth and compressibility assumptions. For vector fields in \(L^1_tW^{1,p}_{\loc,x}\), with \(p>1\), the flow \(\boldsymbol X(t,\cdot)\) is known to satisfy a quantitative local Lipschitz estimate, which implies that it is Lipschitz continuous in the Lusin sense.
